name: meetmaxxing
description: MeetMaxxing — Enterprise AI Meeting Copilot monorepo

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_api_keys.py tests/test_calendar_routes.py -v --tb=short
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.restart: npm run kill && npm run dev
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000
